reason: In packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts, `updateEvent(uid, event)` (line 94) and `deleteEvent(uid)` (line 111) take no externalCalendarId, and both always call the default-calendar URL `/me/calendar/events/${uid}` (lines 96, 113). Only createEvent (lines 75-77) uses the destination calendar. One correction: the interface marks externalCalendarId as optional (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts:226,229), so leaving it out compiles fine and is not strictly 'required'.
